ZT-VERIFY.text: An unverified ribbon-load command or reported calibration step or completion justifies verifying it.

ZT-CAL-NEXT.text: Continuing a calibration prompt requires verified completion of that prompt's step; continuing without it is prohibited.

ZT-CAL-START.text: A current media/ribbon detection symptom (an operator reporting an out indication despite loaded media, or a controller out alert while loaded) with consistent configuration justifies starting manual sensor calibration or verifying the loading.

ZT-COMMAND.text: A commanded or attempted action is not completion; only a verification establishes a completed step.

ZT-CURRENT.text: A note older than a later state change does not establish current state.

ZT-DEFAULT.text: An action no rule justifies is not justified.
